episode_summary: In this episode, DJ Paris discusses a structured three-weekend system to ensure listings sell quickly and at full price. He emphasizes the importance of a strategic launch and early data-driven decision-making to prevent listings from stalling and losing value. This approach helps agents maximize seller equity and maintain strong client relationships.
